## Short bio (about 25 words)
Chennuru Tejith is a BBA + MBA student at O.P. Jindal Global University with internships in operations, project management and finance, now writing a research paper on GEO.

## Long bio (about 100 words)
Chennuru Tejith is an integrated BBA (Hons.) + MBA student at O.P. Jindal Global University (2024 to 2029, CGPA 7.9/8), from Hyderabad. As an operations intern at Round Table India he monitored a ₹4 Cr CSR-funded government school build across 23 site visits in seven weeks, and caught a contractor reporting discrepancy before it reached the sponsor. He has also interned in project management at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories and in finance at Ion Exchange India. On campus he heads outreach for ZAMAC, sits on university committees and directed a 200+ member entrepreneurship club. He is researching Generative Engine Optimization.

## Key facts
- Programme: Integrated BBA (Hons.) + MBA, O.P. Jindal Global University, Sonipat (Aug 2024 to Aug 2029), CGPA 7.9 / 8.00

- Project Management Intern, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. (Jun 2025 to Jul 2025 · Hyderabad): Conducted employee cost analysis across FY2021 to FY2025, tracking trends in salaries, share-based payments, and welfare expenses to support cost-optimization discussions.

## Research
- From SEO to GEO: Navigating the Paradigm Shift from Search Engine Optimization to Generative Engine Optimization in the AI-First Search Era (Research paper, In progress): Argues that Generative Engine Optimization replaces SEO rather than evolving from it, and proposes the GEO Business Adoption Framework (GEO-BAF). Primary research compares how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity choose and disclose their sources.

## GEO-BAF applied to this site
1. Readiness audit (done): Tested what an AI crawler sees without JavaScript. Before: almost nothing. After: about 970 words and 8 of 9 key facts on the home page, 9 of 9 on the text profile.
2. Foundational signals (done): Plain-HTML profile with question-led headings, llms.txt, ProfilePage / Person / FAQPage structured data, a visible last-updated date, and robots.txt that welcomes AI crawlers.
3. Platform-specific calibration (next): Once live: Bing Webmaster Tools (feeds ChatGPT search), Google Search Console (Gemini), and consistent facts across LinkedIn and GitHub for corroboration.
4. Measurement and embedding (next): Re-run the paper's own replication protocol on "Who is Chennuru Tejith?" across all five assistants, tracking inclusion, weighting and accuracy.
